name: smooth dark navy asphalt road like the modern city road, fine low-contrast 2px grain, faded slightly warmer patches, thin crack lines and soft low-contrast stains, its unconnected edges crumbling into dirt in small chunks with a subtle darker lip under the break, laid as a road network with crossroads and dead ends
label: wasteland_ruins/asphalt

surfaces.part: dirt ground base filling the whole sheet
navy asphalt road patches (crossroads, L-bend, T-junctions, dead ends, square and large rectangular slab)

answer.evidence: The image is a flat top-down terrain sheet. Navy asphalt road shapes (a crossroads, an L-bend, T-junctions, dead ends, a small square and a large rectangle) sit on a brown dirt ground that fills all 192 rows at full width 256. The column scan shows only alternating dirt and asphalt color bands along the vertical axis (for example x=64 has dirt rows 4-23, then a navy run at rows 50-57). There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no ellipse and no vertical face. The road edges crumble into dirt with a darker lip, but this is drawn as a flat edge transition, not a south face. The drawing has no front face of 3 or more rows, so it reads as a flat top-down surface, which is normal for a terrain tile.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has only about 12 distinct colours and 5 visible tones per tile. That is above the grass reference (3) and below the paving reference (7). The navy asphalt ramp is shallow, about 3 steps (base navy, a slightly lighter grain, a darker lip), against 5-6 in the references. The dirt surround has a few brown tones with speckle, but its ramp is also thin. Edge pixels carry colour tints (0% neutral), so the outline reads as dark material tone, but it is used inconsistently: the crumbling edge has only a thin dark lip. Near-flat coverage is 10%, and the big navy rectangle shows large flat areas with sparse grain, so it is flatter than the references (0%). The brief also asks for warmer faded patches, thin cracks and soft stains. Only a few cracks are visible, and the patches and stains are barely present. The layout is a scattered set of blobs and a rectangle rather than a clean connected road network with crossroads and dead ends. It would look thinner and flatter than the references, so it fails.
